market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI crude settled ~$102 on May 5 2026, dropping ~4% on Iran ceasefire/deal news. To reach $115 by end of June requires ~13% rally in ~8 weeks — possible only with re-escalation or supply shock. Trend currently bearish. Base rate of such a move in 2 months is ~15-25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran-Israel ceasefire stability and Hormuz transit status are the dominant risks.
